data.title: Islamic University Records 1,964 Research Publications in 2026
data.content:
Madinah, November 16, 2026, SPA -- The Islamic University of Madinah recorded 1,964 scientific publications in 2026, following a total of 3,281 between 2021 and 2025.
    Statistics released during its “Scientific Research Week” forum, which began yesterday, showed that 93% of research produced in the first and second quarters of 2026 appeared in scholarly journals, reflecting the quality of its output.
    The data also showed growth in the university’s research indicators in global rankings. Its performance in the Times Higher Education World University Rankings increased by 56% globally and 23% in the Arab region, while its performance in the QS World University Rankings rose by 177% globally and 211% in the Arab region.
    The university also launched 20 research initiatives, attracting 4,947 applicants. Of these, 3,676 projects were approved, representing an acceptance rate of 74.30%. Funding allocated to post-publication support programs reached SAR50.53 million between 2022 and 2026.
    In addition, 25.2% of the university’s publications in 2026 appeared in journals ranked among the top 10% of sources. This reflects its efforts to enhance quality, advance knowledge, and disseminate its findings through international journals.
    -- SPA
